title: Q-185: WRK-1: Rewrite foundation/ generator against the workers repo layout
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:docs/issues/Q-185.json::Status:\*\* closed
**Status:** closed

Migrated from GitHub issue 185 (Issues are off on the code repository; this file is the record).

Problem: `foundation/` (new-system generator) copies the monorepo `seed/` kernel layout; the code now lives in `ultrastable/workers` (core/, adapters/, bootstrap/), see workers `docs/REPO-MAP.md`.
Paths: foundation/*, tests/foundation/*; target repo ultrastable/workers.
Acceptance: generator emits a new system from workers' template with its tests passing in workers CI; monorepo copies of seed/ and platform/ are retired.
Test plan: `python -m unittest` for foundation tests in the new location. Closing probe: new-system output boots with `bootstrap.py --dry-run`.
Size: M. Owner role: staff. Trigger: after workers PR #1 (merged).
Plus: add the Google Cloud adapter to the generator's runtime choices.

**Disposition:** fixed (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 222.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
